answer:
We have data:

- Belgium: 16.44%
- Dominican Republic: 26.34%
- Croatia: 38.39%
- Belize: 37.32%
- Austria: 29.66%
- Costa Rica: 26.56%

We need the two countries with the most similar amount of protected land percentage-wise. So find pair with smallest difference.

Compute differences:

Belgium vs Dominican: |16.44-26.34|=9.90
Belgium vs Croatia: 22. - to compute: 16.44 vs 38.39 diff=21.95
Belgium vs Belize: 20.88
Belgium vs Austria: 13.22
Belgium vs Costa Rica: 10.12

Dominican vs Croatia: |26.34-38.39|=12.05
Dominican vs Belize: |26.34-37.32|=10.98
Dominican vs Austria: |26.34-29.66|=3.32
Dominican vs Costa Rica: |26.34-26.56|=0.22

Croatia vs Belize: |38.39-37.32|=1.07
Croatia vs Austria: |38.39-29.66|=8.73
Croatia vs Costa Rica: |38.39-26.56|=11.83

Belize vs Austria: |37.32-29.66|=7.66
Belize vs Costa Rica: |37.32-26.56|=10.76

Austria vs Costa Rica: |29.66-26.56|=3.10

Smallest difference is Dominican vs Costa Rica = 0.22. Next is Croatia vs Belize 1.07.

Thus answer: Dominican Republic and Costa Rica.

Provide names only.
Dominican Republic, Costa Rica

- Costa Rica: 26.56%

We need the two countries with the most similar amount of protected land percentage-wise. So find pair with smallest difference.

Compute differences:

Belgium vs Dominican: |16.44-26.34|=9.90
Belgium vs Croatia: 22. - to compute: 16.44 vs 38.39 diff=21.95
Belgium vs Belize: 20.88
Belgium vs Austria: 13.22
Belgium vs Costa Rica: 10.12

Dominican vs Croatia: |26.34-38.39|=12.05
Dominican vs Belize: |26.34-37.32|=10.98
Dominican vs Austria: |26.34-29.66|=3.32
Dominican vs Costa Rica: |26.34-26.56|=0.22

Croatia vs Belize: |38.39-37.32|=1.07
Croatia vs Austria: |38.39-29.66|=8.73
Croatia vs Costa Rica: |38.39-26.56|=11.83

Belize vs Austria: |37.32-29.66|=7.66
Belize vs Costa Rica: |37.32-26.56|=10.76

Austria vs Costa Rica: |29.66-26.56|=3.10

Smallest difference is Dominican vs Costa Rica = 0.22. Next is Croatia vs Belize 1.07.

Thus answer: Dominican Republic and Costa Rica.
